verdict: Ad efficiency surged this period; Google Business activity needs immediate attention.
narrative: Your Meta ads delivered a strong 28-day return on ad spend of 5.48 — up nearly 75% week-over-week — on $1,487.76 in spend, with 44 purchases and $8,157.69 in revenue. That efficiency gain is holding: purchase pace over the last three days matches the three days before, so this is not a one-day spike. On the organic side, your Google Business Profile went from consistent daily engagement in early September to three consecutive days of zero activity through September 19–21; we are investigating the profile now to determine whether this is a data issue or a visibility drop and will have a clear answer this week. Four project milestones from August are still open — the live-cooking video, pre-launch gate, platform audit, and funnel tracking — and resolving those is the top operational priority heading into the September 30 deadline sprint.

highlights.phrase: return on ad spend over the last 28 days, up 75% from the prior week
purchases driven by Meta ads this period, averaging roughly 1–2 per day
total Google Business Profile actions this period — calls, directions, and site clicks — though activity has dropped sharply in the last three days

watch_item.issue: Google Business Profile engagement fell to zero for three consecutive days (Sep 19–21), a confirmed drop, not a data blip.
watch_item.fix: The profile is being reviewed this week to identify and resolve the cause before engagement loss compounds.
